subject: Re: Weekend coverage plan
text:
I am circling back after two days because the weekend shift still needs a clear plan. Sorry I did not confirm earlier.

Two days ago I mentioned the coverage gap and said I would check the calendar before sending details. I have now checked it.

If the queue stays normal, I will take Saturday from seven to three and Sunday from three to eleven. That gives us full coverage during the usual surge hours. You can handle the remaining slots, or we can ask the night team to cover the Sunday evening handoff.

If the billing system remains unstable, I will stay on after three instead. I can answer customer emails, flag repeated outage reports, and leave notes for the on-call engineer. I will not make changes directly unless you or the on-call lead approves them in advance.

On Sunday, I will close the weekend with a short update for the team. It will include ticket volume, unresolved categories, and any accounts that need follow-up on Monday. I will send it by six so it is ready before the next shift.

If this does not work, let me know by tonight and include the exact times you need covered. Otherwise, I will follow the plan and keep messages in the shared channel rather than calling. I will not be reachable between twelve and one, so use that window only for urgent problems.
